A350:
• New: Safety video: put your own video in Documents\Seatback IFE\Safety and name it safety (or safety THY for one airline only). It plays on every seat and wall screen as the pushback starts with the beacon on, instead of the safety cards. The cabin panel's Play Now plays it too.
777:
• New: Safety video: the same on the 777's seat screens, at pushback with the beacon on.
App:
• Beta: the safety video is new and not tested on every setup yet. If it doesn't start or looks wrong, please tell us on Discord.
• New: Settings > Your safety video, with Open folder. MP4 (H.264) at 1280x720 or smaller plays best. Without a video, the safety cards play as before.
